title: Cheap-model Builder reliability and routing hardening
description: Forty bounded packets that make KittyBuilder's cheap paid route executable, truthful, recoverable, and auditable before broader HOME STRETCH product work. The first packets repair exact-model cost projection, refresh the value pair, and make persisted packet routing control both manual CLI and autonomous supervisor execution. This initiative must not claim or duplicate the separate Claude-owned builder-cycle-proof / launcher-cwd-fix lane.
